FORM 52-109F2 - CERTIFICATION OF INTERIM FILINGS BY CFO

desk.headline: Explorer with no revenue; Q3 loss more than doubled to $23.5m as drilling spend rose; no guidance
results: Collective Mining is exploring for gold in Colombia and has no revenue. Its Q3 net loss rose to $23.5m ($0.25 a share) from $10.8m ($0.13), against a $0.13 loss estimate.
Exploration and evaluation spending almost doubled to $17.2m and admin costs doubled to $4.9m.
Cash fell to $70.6m from $129.6m at the start of the year; nine-month operating cash outflow was $43.2m, plus $15.3m spent on land, equipment and concessions.
It bought land around its Guayabales and San Antonio projects on multi-year payment plans (one deal is $33.6m over four years), lifting total liabilities to $52.1m from $12.9m.
Management sees no material doubt about the going concern, but says exploring at the current pace will need more financing.

guidance.summary: The interim filing gives no financial outlook. It says keeping exploration at the current pace will require additional financing.

watch: How and when new funding is raised.
Drilling results and project milestones at Guayabales (Apollo).
Cash spending, including land instalments due in 2027.
